User Guide

This guide covers advanced usage of the Test API.

Configuration

Configure the API with options:

const api = new TestAPI({
  timeout: 5000,
  retries: 3
});

Error Handling

All methods throw TestAPIError on failure:

try {
  await api.call();
} catch (err) {
  if (err instanceof TestAPIError) {
    console.error(err.message);
  }
}
